Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the products of the reaction are NaCl and OH (option B) instead of the correct products, NaCl and H₂O (option D). This error occurred because the Planner misinterpreted the neutralization reaction between HCl (a strong acid) and NaOH (a strong base). The correct reaction produces water (H₂O) as a byproduct along with NaCl, not hydroxide ions (OH). This fundamental misunderstanding of the reaction mechanism led to the wrong conclusion.
